about: Leaving insert mode moves the cursor one character left, but never across a line boundary: at column 1 of a line it stays put. Position rules, so vim-only (the pty engines cannot report a cursor).

cases.name: i<Esc> at column 1 of a line stays on that line
i<Esc> in the middle moves left one
A<Esc> lands on the last character
o<Esc> lands on the new empty line, column 1
iX<Esc> at column 1 leaves the cursor on X
I<Esc> on an indented line stays on that line
a<Esc> at end of line lands on the last character
i<Esc> on an empty line stays at column 1
